text:
marta: follow-up from the 00:30 UTC postmortem. want to lock owners/timelines for remediation + SLO handling. recurring tail-latency spikes during nightly maintenance windows.
owen: can we get the key numbers?
marta: p95 stayed ~170ms, p99 hit 1.7s for ~22m (00:28-00:50 UTC). throughput dropped ~60%. rolling-week error-budget burn up ~17%. happened 3x in the last month.
liam: root cause summary: pool churn + backup IO alignment causing cold-start pileups; autoscaler reacts too slowly.
alert-bot: incident-3501234567 logged: https://incidents.redwood/3501234567  severity=P2.
marta: proposed run of actions: (A) no global SLO loosen; (B) add a scheduled alert-tolerance window for 00:15-01:00 UTC to avoid noisy pages while we fix; (C) implement route-level graceful degradation (shift portion to lite-model) on tail triggers; (D) standby small warm-reservoir during rollout/backups; (E) dashboard + error-budget projection + per-customer SLA headroom panel.
owen: prefer window + graceful-degrade + warm-reservoir. keeps guarantees intact and reduces pager noise.
cs-anya: customer note: if graceful-degrade affects an SLA customer for >30m cumulative we need to notify. prepare a short template.
liam: owners + deadlines suggestion: Owen - dashboard + error-budget panel + CS headroom table by Wed EOD; Infra-oncall - standby-reservoir PR and canary by Mon; Liam - fallback route prototype + canary Tue; Marta - runbook + SLO policy note + exec one-pager by Thu.
owen: dashboard draft (promql) I'll add:
```
# p99 split by instance_warm and route_degraded for /v1/generate
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le, instance_warm, route_degraded))
```
liam: fallback plan: if p99>900ms for 2m mark route_degraded=true and shift 25% traffic to lite-variant; page only if route_degraded=true AND error_budget_burn>5%/day. will add regression tests.
infra-oncall: standby-reservoir plan: reserve 3 warm instances per region during rollout windows, flag controlled by schedule. PR today, staging canary Tue 00:30, prod Thu 00:30. will include cost delta.
alert-bot: action items added to incident checklist: Owen(dashboard), Infra-oncall(standby-reservoir), Liam(fallback), Marta(runbook). Deadlines recorded.
marta: decision check  keep SLOs unchanged, implement alert window + fallback + standby-reservoir, notify SLA customers only if affected >30m. react with :thumbsup: to approve.
owen: :thumbsup:
liam: :thumbsup:
infra-oncall: :thumbsup:
cs-anya: :thumbsup:
marta: small follow-ups: Owen add error-budget projection panel showing days-to-zero and a top-10 customers SLA headroom table; Infra include a schedule flag to trial only in rollout windows; Liam add CI regression to avoid flappy fallback.
owen: noted, will include projection and CS table.
infra-oncall: will include schedule flag and cost estimate in PR.
liam: regression tests will be in perf CI and block merges if unstable.
marta: I'll post the exec one-pager tomorrow morning and attach the customer note template. if anything blocks owners flag here and we'll escalate. :eyes:
